decision.title: A year card or a month card?
decision.description: Compare whole membership payments over an editable window, then explore how each arrangement could fit your life.
decision.originalInput: An offline example: a year card costs $600 per year and a month card costs $60 per month.

tags.name: Building a steady routine
tags.description: Explore how a recurring membership could settle into your routine.

targets.consideration: If you keep returning regularly, a prepaid period could become part of a steady routine without a fresh purchase each month.
If you keep returning regularly, each renewal could become a recurring point to continue or change your routine.

tags.name: A changing schedule
tags.description: Imagine a period when competing commitments interrupt your usual use.

targets.consideration: If other commitments interrupt your use, prepaid access could remain available while you are away; any pause or refund terms need verification.
If other commitments interrupt your use, you could revisit the next purchase subject to the actual renewal terms.

tags.name: Room in your current budget
tags.description: Explore paying for a longer period at once or funding shorter periods as they arrive.

targets.consideration: If the larger initial payment competes with other needs, you may have less uncommitted cash at the start.
If smaller payments fit your cash flow, you may spread the outlay across successive renewals.

tags.name: Trying it before committing
tags.description: Explore finding out whether this membership remains useful after getting started.

targets.consideration: If the experience turns out to fit differently than expected, unused access may remain within the prepaid period.
If the experience turns out to fit differently than expected, a coming renewal may offer an earlier point to reassess under the actual terms.

tags.name: Changing where you live
tags.description: Imagine moving away from the place or service this membership supports.

targets.consideration: If your location changes, the usefulness of remaining access depends on portability and transfer terms.
If your location changes, the next renewal could be a point to change arrangements, subject to notice requirements.

tags.name: Managing renewals
tags.description: Explore how renewal decisions fit into your ongoing responsibilities.

targets.consideration: If renewals happen less often, a renewal date could be easier to overlook unless you keep a reminder.
If renewal decisions recur more often, they may become a regular administrative task or an automatic payment depending on the terms.

facts.subscriptionCostComparison: Year card costs $1,200.00 and Month card costs $780.00 over 13 months.
